source.what: curve conditions (HI 14.6:2016, water 68 F, NPSH at max impeller)

notes: Max-diameter (9.84 in) curve of the 4-pole, 60 Hz chart, impeller label as printed. Speed is stated only as 4-pole 60 Hz; rpm 1750 is the nominal 4-pole figure, not a number printed in the booklet. Flow 0 point is the thin extension line (the booklet says thin parts are not a recommended operating range; do not run below 0.1 x Qmax). Head ft, flow gpm as printed. bhp = pump input P2 read from the P2 [hp] curve of the same chart (the chart also has a kW axis); kw = bhp*0.7457. NPSHr from the NPSH curve, which the booklet says is shown for the maximum impeller size (maximum measured values). eff_pct_derived is NOT a published number: it is Q*H/(3960*P2) from the published H and P2 curves. It corresponds to the pump hydraulic efficiency that the booklet's dashed iso-efficiency lines show; the highest iso-efficiency label near this curve is 61.8% (read visually) as a cross-check. Motor hp from the TEFC dimension table row for this impeller size (4-pole). Motor voltage/FLA are not in this booklet (motor is a separate NEMA Premium / Super Premium selection). Max liquid temperature 284 F is the booklet-wide range (-10 to 284 F depending on shaft seal), not a per-model figure, so left null. NSF 50/61 appear as option columns in the product range tables; per-model applicability was not extracted. Smaller impeller trims are on the same chart page but were not digitized.
